info.title: SBS Service Observability API
info.description: Reviewed Community read-only Phase-Y views and operational health surfaces served by sbs-service. Collection failures are normally represented inside the versioned view envelope rather than as a non-2xx transport status.

tags.name: SBS views
tags.description: Read-only cluster, node, volume, maintenance, capacity, and reclaim views.

tags.name: Operations views
tags.description: Membership, operation, query, MCP, GUI, and workflow views.

get.description: Returns 503 while the process is not locally ready or, when leader election is configured, while it is not mutation-ready. Dependency loss is reported separately by /dependency.
get.x-namrbd-authority: sbs-service local readiness and leader lease

get.description: Always returns HTTP 200. Dependency state and the fail-open serving/fail-closed mutation behavior are carried in the JSON body.

get.x-namrbd-authority: sbs-service runtime, cluster metadata, and maintenance workers

get.summary: Read the complete SBS observability snapshot
get.description: Unlike the other Phase-Y routes, this route returns the Snapshot directly rather than wrapping it in View.data.
get.x-namrbd-authority: sbs-service AdminService, cluster metadata, and sbs-data health detail
get.x-namrbd-feature-gate: always; bounded collectors may report a partial or degraded snapshot

HealthOK.description: The process is alive or ready.

NotReady.description: The process is not locally ready or is not leader-ready.

PrometheusMetrics.description: Prometheus text exposition for readiness, leadership, TiKV requests, internal RPC classes, maintenance, capacity, and reclaim state.

ViewEnvelope.description: The fixed metadata from observability.View. data is selected per route and remains open to avoid overstating map-assembled response closure.

Snapshot.description: observability.Snapshot. Optional fields follow Go omitempty behavior; the object remains open for compatible observability additions.
